risks.proof: A clear photo of the internal rollers and the print head area.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged internal mechanism

risks.risk: The unit may be a generic copy machine rather than a Sharp brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the back or side.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the back or side).
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the internal rollers and print head area.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
